items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal to fell the two lime trees
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Landkreis Musterpeene, Kreishausweg 1, 17109 Musterdemmin.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post. Per the letter's own stated rule (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V) it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 19.11. + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Monday); this day is not a Sunday/holiday so no shift. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day, 24.11.2026, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on the day numerically corresponding to the start day minus one, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a working day in MV (not a Sunday/holiday, and 24.12 is not a statutory holiday), so the deadline stays at 23.12.2026. Note: a stricter transitional rule (§ 120a VwVfG M-V, 3-day delivery) could apply if this matter began before 1 Jan 2025, which would move delivery to 22.11.2026 and the deadline to 22.12.2026; nothing in the letter indicates the application predates 2025, so the 4-day rule as stated in the letter is used.

warnings: The letter mentions a possible older 3-day deemed-delivery rule (§ 120a VwVfG M-V) that could apply if this application was filed before 1 January 2025; if so the Widerspruch deadline would be one day earlier (22.12.2026) — check when the original Antrag was filed.
To be safe, send the Widerspruch early enough (e.g. by 17.12.2026) to allow for postal transit and still arrive by the deadline.
